previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A homeless man with a history of systolic heart failure, atrial fibrillation, COPD, and chronic hepatitis C presented with worsening right toe pain, discoloration, and symptoms of heart failure including shortness of breath, leg swelling, and orthopnea. He had been non-adherent with antibiotics from a prior admission. Evaluation showed no acute infection or cardiopulmonary disease; X-rays revealed unchanged chronic osteomyelitis. Podiatry recommended no antibiotics or procedure, attributing the toe changes to chronic eschar and microvascular disease. He was treated for acute on chronic heart failure with increased furosemide and monitored for renal function, which improved with diuresis. Due to patient preference, he was discharged after one day with a plan for outpatient follow-up, despite not being fully optimized. Discharge included medication adjustments and instructions for weight monitoring and prompt follow-up.
problems: Acute on chronic systolic heart failure
Chronic airway obstruction, not elsewhere classified
Chronic hepatitis C without mention of hepatic coma
Coronary atherosclerosis of native coronary artery

Dear Mr. ___,

___. You were admitted to the hospital because of 
shortness of breath due to congestive heart failure (from not 
taking your torsemide) as well as a COPD exacerbation. You 
improved with diuretics to remove extra fluid. Your wheezing and 
shortness of breath improved with nebulizers, steroids, and 
antibiotics. Your dose of Torsemide will be 40mg a day, which is 
2 pills.

first going to be discharged that we believe was due to a 
""vasovagal"" episode. This likely meant that you were likely 
slightly dry (or over diuresed). This is why it is very 
important that you continue to monitor your weights.

Please take all of your medications as prescribed. We started 
you on a new medication called Spironolactone to help with your 
heart failure.

Weigh yourself every morning, call MD if weight goes up more 
than 3 lbs. Your new ""dry"" weight is 98.6kg (216.9lbs).
